Tag suffix merge, whitespace normalization, empty-tag refusal and exception classification not modeled by write_prefix

Exception recognizer/delegation not represented by boolean classification alone

important_limit: Eligible means an exact scoped source distinction exists in the translation under listed premises, not whole-member coverage, native agreement, final-control success or ObjectScript implementation proof. Shared functions do not by themselves prove every mapped body. Final parent ledger must count actual qualified union and preserve withdrawals.
